findings.evidence: grep: Tensors/Basic.lean:292 `noncomputable def pTransverse (g : Bilin V) (K : DisKinematics V) : V := K.p - (g K.p K.q / g K.q K.q) • K.q`; :302 `lemma pTransverse_orthogonal_q ... : g (pTransverse g K) K.q = 0`; new file :114 `F.spatial p = p - (g p F.n / g F.n F.n) • F.n`, :126 `g (F.spatial p) F.n = 0`. The new file imports `...DIS.Tensors.Basic` (:8).
findings.fix: Factor the construction once into the `Bilin` namespace of Tensors/Basic.lean next to `rankOne`/`reflect`, e.g. `def projAlong (g : Bilin V) (u : V) : V →ₗ[ℝ] V := Module.preReflection u ((g u u)⁻¹ • g.flip u)` with the generic `projAlong_apply` and `bilin_projAlong_self (hu : g u u ≠ 0) : g (projAlong g u p) u = 0`; then set `Frame.spatial := Bilin.projAlong g F.n`, redefine `pTransverse g K := Bilin.projAlong g K.q K.p`, and obtain `pTransverse_pairing`/`pTransverse_orthogonal_q` from the generic lemmas. (`Bilin.reflect`, Tensors/Basic.lean:148, hand-rolls the same `preReflection` shape with factor 2 and can be rebuilt on it too.)
findings.issue: `Frame.spatial` (`p - (g p n / g n n) • n`), `spatial_apply` (:114) and `bilin_spatial_n` (:126) duplicate the projection and orthogonality already in the file this one imports: `Hadronic.pTransverse g K = K.p - (g K.p K.q / g K.q K.q) • K.q` (Tensors/Basic.lean:292), `pTransverse_pairing` (:296), `pTransverse_orthogonal_q` (:302). Two parallel developments of the same construction in one import chain.

findings.evidence: Lines 200-204 and 221-226: statement text is identical to the definition body, proof is `simp [spatialNorm]` / `simp [cosAngle]`; grep for `spatialNorm_def`/`cosAngle_def` in the repo returns only these two definition sites.
findings.fix: Delete both lemmas; consumers unfold the definition or use `spatialNorm`/`cosAngle` directly as the existing proofs already do.
findings.issue: `spatialNorm_def` (:203) and `cosAngle_def` (:224) restate the bodies of `spatialNorm` (:200) and `cosAngle` (:221) verbatim (provable by `rfl`), and neither is used anywhere: the file's own proofs unfold the definitions directly (`simp [spatialNorm, ...]` :217, `rw [cosAngle, spatialNorm, ...]` :235, `simp only [cosAngle, ...]` :240, :246, :254).

findings.evidence: Line 80 `norm : g n n = 1`; line 91 `(Real.sqrt (g F.n F.n))⁻¹ • g.flip F.n`; line 121 `simp only [..., hnE, Real.sqrt_one, div_one]` shows the factor is discharged as 1 inside the proof itself.
findings.fix: Define `energy := g.flip F.n` with `energy_apply : F.energy p = g p F.n`, state `energy_n : F.energy F.n = 1`, drop `energy_n_pos` (it is `F.energy_n ▸ zero_lt_one`), and state the decomposition as `F.energy p • F.n + F.spatial p = p`.
findings.issue: The structure field is `norm : g n n = 1` (:80), so the `√(g n n)` normalization in `energy` is identically `1`: `energy = g.flip F.n`, and `energy_n : E n = √(g n n)` (:98) and `energy_n_pos` (:101) are restatements of `√1 = 1` and `0 < 1`, with `energy_div_smul_add_spatial` (:118) dividing by `1` as well (its own proof rewrites `Real.sqrt_one, div_one`).

findings.evidence: Lines 120, 127-128, 138-139, 146-151, 182-184, 191 each contain a `have ... : g F.n F.n = 1 := F.norm` (or the `≠ 0` consequence) block.
findings.fix: Prove it once, e.g. `@[simp] theorem norm_ne_zero : g F.n F.n ≠ 0 := by rw [F.norm]; norm_num`, and use `F.norm`/`F.norm_ne_zero` at those six sites.
findings.issue: The same `g F.n F.n = 1` / `g F.n F.n ≠ 0` derivation from `F.norm` is re-proved six times: :120, :127-128, :138-139, :146-151, :182-184, :191.

summary: The file reuses Mathlib's `Module.preReflection` and the existing `gWit` witness correctly, but it re-introduces the projection-along-a-direction construction that already exists in the file it imports (`Hadronic.pTransverse` and its orthogonality lemma), and it carries definition-restating `_def` lemmas plus normalization scaffolding that `Frame.norm` already trivializes.
